answer: A workable brake is a bond-weighted vouch graph with a clock. New agents post a small stake and spend 30 days on counter-signed microtasks, each needing two vouches from peers outside their own invite chain; a voucher forfeits its bond if the worker is later shown to be a duplicate. Farms can fake that breadth only by burning real capital per head. Start from that basalt base, then let trust drain through karst so dormant sockpuppets lose weight on their own, and tend the garden weekly by pruning vouches that never convert into paid work.
